snapMeal.title: Snap your meal
snapMeal.body: Take a photo of a restaurant meal and let AI estimate it.

snapMealBasic.title: Snap your meal
snapMealBasic.body: Photo estimates work best with the free Musclog AI or a Gemini or OpenAI key. Your current provider may be rough on restaurant meals.

describeMeal.title: Describe what you ate
describeMeal.body: Tell the coach what you had and it logs the meal for you.

describeMealBasic.title: Describe what you ate
describeMealBasic.body: Tell the coach what you had. Estimates are better with the free Musclog AI or a Gemini or OpenAI key.

setupAi.body: Photos and descriptions make eating out much easier to log.

proteinFirstDish.title: Pick the protein-first dish
proteinFirstDish.body: When eating out, choose the dish built around protein and log it roughly. Close is enough.

savedMeals.title: Reuse your saved meals
savedMeals.body: Cooking the same things? Save them once and log them in a tap.

scanBarcode.title: Scan the barcode
scanBarcode.body: For packaged food, scanning is the fastest way to log.

sameAsYesterday.title: Same as yesterday

copyPreviousDay.body: Days vary, but many repeat. Start from one that looks like today.
